title: Mount Wilson cover-up: buried fried servers and rail system

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for reports of strange events, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a site on Mount Wilson, said to be property of the businessman Robert Bigelow. He says that from around 1996 onward his team found evidence of earlier activity there and a cover-up, including buried, burned-out computer servers and a buried rail system. If true, it would mean someone did secret work at the site and tried to hide it.
